rows.title: RED signed in greater Rosario corridor
rows.body:
Nov 2025

Choice Hotels extended its CALA footprint in Argentina with Radisson RED Funes in the greater Rosario area—named alongside Radisson Blu Bariloche and Radisson Hotel Paramaribo as new-market entries in the Americas portfolio.

https://media.choicehotels.com/2025-11-19-Choice-Hotels-International-to-Make-Landmark-Entry-into-Africa-Starting-with-Three-Hotels-in-Kenya

rows.title: Radisson RED Miraflores live on ChoiceHotels.com
rows.body:
Jul 2023

Choice completed Radisson Hotels Americas integration ahead of schedule—adding hundreds of upscale hotels to ChoiceHotels.com including Radisson RED Hotel Miraflores in Lima, Peru, with Choice Privileges earn and redeem.

https://media.choicehotels.com/2023-07-26-Choice-Hotels-Completes-Radisson-Hotels-Americas-Milestone,-Integrating-Loyalty-Programs-And-Allowing-For-Full-Booking-Capabilities-On-ChoiceHotels-com

rows.title: Americas RED system scale (press kit)
rows.body:
Sep 2023

Choice media center cites 4 Radisson RED hotels with 606 rooms in operation and 5 under development across the Americas as of September 30, 2023—upscale select-service urban social positioning with OUIBar + KTCHN and 24/7 fitness.

https://media.choicehotels.com/Radisson-Red-press-kit
